investigation_notes: Reliability incident investigation of a production environment. Evidence consists of Elasticsearch aggregation results over application and proxy logs, Kubernetes, cloud-provider and host system events, Prometheus Alertmanager alerts, change-management / CI-CD audit records and metric anomaly detection. No root cause, impact or trigger is stated; these must be established from the supplied artifacts. Environment context: Organization: Cedarhollow Travel (travel booking); Platform: AWS eu-central-1 (zones eu-central-1a/eu-central-1b/eu-central-1c); network range 10.43.0.0/16; Kubernetes cluster cedarh-prod-eucent (EKS); Caching tier: self-managed Redis (cache-redis-02, maxmemory 4gb, allkeys-lru) in front of the fares-svc PostgreSQL database fares-db-01; Change management: production changes carry CHG- identifiers.
